claims.evidence: One source per (cell line/SILAC channel, MaxQuant experiment, sample type). The experiment key is taken from the MaxQuant experiment names in the deposited mqpar.xml files (COR set: dates 0701/0708/0709/0716/0720 and BR3/BR4/BR5; AZR set: R1-R3 for the Orbitrap Elite protein/pST experiments, 2018R1-R3 for the 20180213_..._SILAC_<cond>_R<n>_Total experiments, pYD1-3/pYA1-3 for 20180108_Andy_Tapan_pY_<D|A><n>, BR4-BR7 for the H1975_AZR3_AZR4_BR<n> pY experiments). H1975 names carry AZRset/CORset because each 3-state mix had its own H1975 culture. Protein (total proteome), pST (TiO2) and pY (anti-pY antibody) material of one mix get separate source names (separate pull-downs / aliquots, precedent PXD010683), sharing the biological replicate number.

claims.value: SILAC light = NCI-H1975; SILAC medium = AZR3 / COR1; SILAC heavy = AZR4 / COR10
claims.evidence: PRIDE sample protocol: "The three state SILAC-labeled cells were TKI-sensitive cell line H1975 (light), the TKI-resistant cell lines AZR3 and COR1 (medium), and the TKI-resistant cell lines AZR4 and COR10 (heavy). The medium state cells were labeled with 13C6-Arg/D4-Lys and the heavy state cells were labeled with 13C615N4-Arg/13C615N2-Lys." All 12 mqpar.xml: multiplicity 3, labelMods ["", "Arg6;Lys4", "Arg10;Lys8"]. Data check (orientation.txt): in all 17 protein experiments the paper markers point the same way with L as the sensitive parent: TK1, PAK1, PIP4K2C log2 M/L and H/L < 0 (paper: decreased in all resistant lines); PTK7 > 0 (increased in all resistant); AXL > 0 where quantified (paper: up in resistant); NT5E, ALCAM > 0 and FN1, TGM2 < 0 in AZR experiments vs NT5E, ALCAM < 0 and FN1, TGM2 > 0 in COR experiments (paper Fig 3B / text: opposite in osimertinib- vs rociletinib-resistant cells); CDH1 < 0 in COR roci (paper: E-cadherin decreased). The medium-vs-heavy assignment (AZR3 vs AZR4, COR1 vs COR10) rests on the PRIDE protocol statement only; no deposited marker separates the two resistant clones.

Paper: "H1975 parental cell line was obtained from ATCC. The resistant cell lines AZR3/AZR4 (resistant to osimertinib) and COR1/COR10 (resistant to rociletinib) ... were obtained from AstraZeneca and Clovis Oncology"; "the corresponding isogenic osimertinib (AZR3 and AZR4) or rociletinib (COR1 and COR10) resistant cell lines". NCI-H1975 = EFO:0002271 label NCI-H1975. The derived lines have no Cellosaurus entry (none of the 28 children of CVCL_1511 is AZR3/AZR4/COR1/COR10; CVCL_WV99 NCI-H1975/OSIR is a different line from PubMed 27835594). The bare names collide with other species (Azr3 CVCL_5A63 Chinese hamster; Cor1 CVCL_A5EM mouse), so they are written with the parental prefix NCI-H1975/.

CVCL_1511 = NCI-H1975 (ID NCI-H1975, SY H1975). For the four derived resistant lines, which have no Cellosaurus entry, the parental accession is given (isogenic derivatives, paper), as accepted in campaign precedent PXD010683.

Custom column (spec "Extending Templates"), as in precedents PXD010683/PXD018305.

PRIDE protocol: "Each set of the SILAC labeled cells were treated either with DMSO or the corresponded drugs (50 nM osimertinib or 100 nM rociletinib) for one hour, respectively before harvesting." Paper Fig 1A: "TKI-sensitive H1975, osimertinib-resistant AZR3/AZR4 cells, and rociletinib-resistant COR1/COR10 cells were treated with DMSO or the corresponding TKI". The treatment of each run comes from the MaxQuant search it belongs to (*_DMSO_* vs *_osi_* / *_roci_* searches; raw names DMSO/nodrug vs AZD/CO1686). All three channels of a mix share the treatment. NCIT:C437 Dimethyl Sulfoxide, NCIT:C116377 Osimertinib, NCIT:C99905 Rociletinib. The DMSO arm is a vehicle control, so it is written as the vehicle rather than "untreated" (batch rule 4 targets controls with no agent).
PRIDE protocol "(50 nM osimertinib or 100 nM rociletinib)"; DMSO volume/concentration not stated.
PRIDE protocol: treated "for one hour ... before harvesting" (both DMSO and drug arms).

pST rows: TiO2 phosphopeptide enrichment of 9/10 of each bRPLC fraction (PRIDE protocol); pY rows: PhosphoScan p-Tyr-100 / p-Tyr-1000 immunoaffinity enrichment (PRIDE protocol). Run membership from the pST_* and pY_* MaxQuant searches. EFO:0010806 enrichment of phosphorylated protein (child of EFO:0009090). Source-name suffix _pST / _pY distinguishes the two enrichments.
Total-proteome runs: "1/10th of the peptides was injected directly for LC-MS/MS analysis" (no enrichment); run membership from the protein(s)_* MaxQuant searches.

NCI-H1975 DMSO appears in both sets (separate cultures per mix): COR mixes 1-3, AZR mixes 4-12.

limitations: Excluded runs (14 of 666, partial scope): R4_F9 and Xu-BR4-1..Xu-BR4-12 are named BR4/R4 but every deposited MaxQuant file (mqpar.xml and experimentalDesignTemplate.txt of H1975_COR1_COR10_pST_roci) assigns them to experiment H1975_COR1_COR10_CO1686_pST_BR3; H1975_COR1_COR10_CO1686_BR3_pY100_2ndbinding_a is named BR3 but assigned to experiment H1975_COR1_COR10_CO1686_0708 in H1975_COR1_COR10_pY_roci. The sample identity of these files cannot be settled from the deposit; they are left out and listed in annotations/BLOCKED.md.
Three runs listed in H1975_AZR3_AZR4_pY_osi mqpar.xml (H1975_AZR3_AZR4_SILAC_pY_R1, _R2, _R3) were never deposited; they have no rows.

Biological-replicate linkage in the AZR set is partly undocumented: the paper says three AZR biological replicates, but the deposit holds Orbitrap Elite protein/pST experiments R1-R3 (2015-2016), QE HF *_Total R1-R3 protein experiments (2018), QE HF pY experiments D1-D3/A1-A3 (2018) and pY BR4-BR7. Only R1-R3 protein and pST share labels and are linked; the others got separate numbers. If the 2018 Total and 2018 pY mixes are the same cultures (or the same as R1-R3), the replicate numbers overcount independent cultures.

Medium vs heavy channel identity (AZR3 vs AZR4, COR1 vs COR10) is supported by the PRIDE protocol statement only; deposited ratios confirm that light is the sensitive parent but cannot distinguish the two resistant clones.

The paper says the osimertinib (AZR) experiments used the Q Exactive HF and the rociletinib (COR) experiments the Orbitrap Elite; raw headers show AZR 2015-2016 protein/pST runs on the Orbitrap Elite and COR rociletinib BR3-BR5 runs on a Q Exactive. Per-file raw headers were used. PRIDE instruments field lists "LTQ Orbitrap Elite, Q Exactive". sdrf-tools reconcile flags instrument_contradicted because the PRIDE protocol text names only the Q Exactive HF; that is refuted by the raw headers.

Search parameters conflict between text and deposit: paper/PRIDE say MaxQuant 1.5.7.4, deamidation (NQ) variable, 7 ppm precursor; the deposited mqpar.xml/parameters.txt say MaxQuant 1.5.3.17/1.5.3.28/1.5.3.30, no deamidation, 4.5 ppm main search. The deposited parameters are used.
Collision energy not given: sampled methods show NCE 32 (Orbitrap Elite), 30 (Q Exactive BR3_F1) while the protocol says 40%; it was not verified per file, so the column is omitted.
Supplementary Materials and Methods of PMC8182571 are not retrievable (Europe PMC: not open access); cell culture, SILAC and pY enrichment details come from the PRIDE protocol text.

The pY runs (fraction identifier 1..n) mix antibody types (pY100/pY1000), first/second binding, eluate/flow-through and re-injections within one MaxQuant experiment; the deposit does not describe these sub-runs beyond their names, so they are enumerated, not interpreted. "FT" (flow-through) pY runs are still annotated with the enrichment process of their search.
NCI-H1975/AZR3, /AZR4, /COR1, /COR10 have no Cellosaurus entries; validate-sdrf may warn that they are not found in CLO/BTO/EFO.
PRIDE v3 file listing pages after page 0 timed out; the file inventory comes from the FTP directory listing (735 entries) instead.
